app_type: Hybrid B2B/B2C Material Marketplace & Designer Hub

design_persona.name: E1 The Anti-AI Architectural Designer
design_persona.emotional_archetype: Swiss & Architectural High-Contrast (Trust, Blueprint Rigor, Material Warmth)
design_persona.visual_mood: Clean, structural, highly readable, matte stone surfaces with blueprint grid accents and energetic amber/terracotta calls to action.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous structural margins (2-3x default) with blueprint grid dividers and rounded-xl card containers.

navigation_header.components: Brand logo, Category nav, Search bar with filter tags, Cart icon with badge count, Role switcher dropdown (Kontraktor, Supplier, Desainer), Auth status/Google Login simulation
navigation_header.styling: Sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200

role_onboarding_modal.purpose: First-time or role-switch onboarding selecting Kontraktor/Pemilik Proyek, Supplier Material, or Desainer Interior
role_onboarding_modal.styling: Centrally aligned dialog with interactive persona cards, privilege bullet points, and instant dashboard redirect

tiered_pricing_calculator.concept: Dynamic unit pricing based on quantity (1-50 lembar retail vs >50 lembar grosir discount)
tiered_pricing_calculator.component_behavior: Live discount calculation display on product modal & cart page

3d_asset_market_card.features: Preview renders viewer, Instant download button after escrow checkout confirmation

escrow_payment_flow.actions: Buyer 'Konfirmasi & Rilis Dana' button, Supplier 'Input Resi/Progress' form

dashboards.supplier: Kelola Stok Material, Setting Price Tiers (Eceran vs Grosir), Pesanan B2B Masuk
dashboards.designer: Upload Aset 3D, Paketan Jasa Desain/RAB/DED, Transaksi Download Aset
dashboards.buyer_contractor: Riwayat Pesanan Escrow, Unduhan Aset 3D Saya, Keranjang & Checkout

instructions_to_main_agent: Use exact Bahasa Indonesia terminology for architectural & B2B trading terms (e.g. 'Plywood / Multiplek', 'Harga Grosir >50 Lembar', 'Gambar Kerja DED', 'Escrow Payment (Dana Ditahan System)', 'Rencana Anggaran Biaya (RAB)').
Ensure every clickable button, input, tab, filter, and badge contains kebab-case data-testid attributes for E2E testing.
Ensure the tiered price calculator instantly updates totals when input quantity changes above 50 units.
Provide seed mock data in FastAPI for products, services, 3D assets, escrow orders, and supplier inventory so the application is fully interactive on first launch.
Implement the Escrow Payment timeline visually with active status highlights (Holding -> Shipped -> Buyer Confirmed -> Released).
Include direct file download simulation for purchased 3D assets (.skp, .d5, .fbx).
